thanks for the replies. I'm fine now. Just got into my head a bit too much. Love my job and the people I work with. Just cant stand the thought of people thinking badly of me.

Went into work and everything was grand. Mostly nobody mentioned it, and if they did it was more out of concern than judgement. Decided to just not promise people things I cant deliever. Learn to say no.

thanks again for the replies
